sections.name: theme
sections.prompt: Dark retro synthwave instrumental, 108 BPM, D minor, brooding and cinematic. Steady four-on-the-floor kick, deep gated-reverb snare, warm pulsing analog bassline, low-pass filtered arpeggio, dark analog pads, and one slow, memorable lead melody on a mellow, warm synth. Night over Earth from orbit: tense, focused, determined.
